pages.brief: A wooden bird table scattered with loose seeds and broken shells, a bird flying off in the background.
Moss the hedgehog standing at the base of a bird table, looking up at scattered seeds on the ground around him.
Moss the hedgehog gathering scattered seeds and shells into a small neat pile on the grass.
Moss the hedgehog sweeping loose shells together using a long thin twig like a little broom.
The ground beneath a bird table now neat and clear, with one tidy pile of seeds at the base.
Nell the bee landing to feed from a tidy bird table while Moss the hedgehog watches contentedly from below.
